claims.disproof_condition: 條件：聯亞的重大訊息或財報寫出這份基板長約縮減、終止，或基板不足造成出貨下滑。核查頻率：每季（聯亞重大訊息與財報）。觸發後 48 小時：本 claim 加註，InP 基板層與 InP 磊晶片層讀圖重讀。
claims.statement: LandMark (an InP epiwafer maker) is signing a 4-year long-term purchase agreement (2026–2029) with an unnamed Japanese InP substrate supplier and its Taiwan subsidiary 'to ensure stable supply of the key raw material, InP substrates'. Counterparty is undisclosed and must not be inferred (INV-1).
